turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! In a simple English statement the order is subject, then verb, then object, with place or time at the end. Frequency words like always, usually and never go before the main verb. Example: We usually have lunch at one.

Try this: Put in order: "often / my aunt / tea / makes"
